name: Paper
tagline: Design canvas built on HTML and CSS
description: Paper lets agents read and write the design file that is open in Paper Desktop: inspect artboards, selections, computed styles, JSX and tokens, and create or change frames, text and styles. Install Paper Desktop, open it once, and open a file before you start. OpenBot starts the Paper CLI that Paper Desktop installs at ~/.paper/bin/paper. Paper needs no key. Write tools change the open file, so review each write before you approve it.

prompts.text: Implement the selected Paper frame in this codebase, with our code conventions.
Use the styles in this repository and design a settings page in Paper.
List the design tokens in the open Paper file and compare them with our theme.

apps.name: Paper
apps.description: Reads and writes the open Paper Desktop file, over the local MCP server that the Paper CLI relays. Needs Paper Desktop with a file open.
